newsitem.title: UK: Financials give managers best returns in March.
newsitem.headline: Financials give managers best returns in March.

text.p: Futures managers who traded in the financial markets realised the best returns during March, according to data and research company TASS Management Ltd
In its Flash Report for March TASS said many of the top-performing managers for the month earned most of their trading gains by shorting U.S. stock index and bond contracts.
Profits were also made by going long in the grain markets such as soya beans and meal and also in the base metals markets, TASS said.
"March was a respectable month for futures traders, but performance wasn't nearly as good as it had been in either January or February,' Nicola Meaden, TASS chief-executive of management said.
Meaden also noted that, for the first time in six months, profits from foreign exchange trading did not contribute substantially to the performance of the top ten managers for the month.
TASS follows the performance of 70 futures and currency managers, each with a minimum of $45 under management.
